candidates.change_summary: Changed the constructor-like function XBornID to assign totalDistributed to caller instead of owner, so balances[msg.sender] is set rather than balances[owner].
Removed the require check so anyone can call XBornID, allowing balances[caller] to be set to totalDistributed by any caller.
Modified XBornID to set balances[owner] to zero instead of totalDistributed, changing post-call balances at key owner.
Modified XBornID to increment balances[owner] by totalDistributed instead of assigning, altering owner's balance.
